lede: A scenario guide built on the official exam objectives, the prep kit's quick-recall notes, and 112 scenario questions with the answer shown the moment you choose.

bankNotes.fresh: Written against the CCAR-P Exam Guide objectives. Option lengths are balanced, so length gives nothing away.
bankNotes.original: From girishr/ClaudeCertifiedArchitect-Professional-Prep (CC BY 4.0), with option lengths rebalanced so length gives nothing away.
bankNotes: All banks mixed. Each question shows which bank it comes from.
bankNotes.matrix: Each question lists several statements; pick a value from the dropdown next to each. A question counts as correct only when every row is right.
